description: Ongevallen CSI is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. CSI of Common Safety Indicators die jaarlijks de opvolging van de algemene evolutie van de spoorwegveiligheid toelaten en die de evaluatie van het realiseren van de gemeenschappelijke veiligheidsdoelstellingen vergemakkelijken. Ze zijn gebaseerd op Europese normen en de indicatoren nemen significante ongevallen op. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Veiligheid. Its keywords are Ongevallen, Overweg. The portal shows 2022-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
